{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dark green velvet-textured blazer, tailored single-breasted cut, hip length, deep forest green #2F4A3A, cotton-velvet blend

Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft bow at the neck, long sleeves, cream #F1E8D8, matte crepe de chine

Midi skirt, A-line cut, falling just below the knee, charcoal #3C3F46, fine wool crepe

Sheer tights, sleek finish, soft black #1C1C1E, nylon blend

Ankle boots, block heel of about 5 cm, almond toe, black #151515, smooth leather

Structured top-handle bag, small, in burgundy #6B2A3A, smooth leather

Drop earrings, small, in antique gold #B08D57, brushed metal

Why this outfit works: it sits squarely in the neat band for an autumn evening at the theatre, with a blouse, skirt, textured jacket and ankle boots all in the expected vocabulary. The velvety blazer and silk bow blouse add richness that reads well under artificial stage and foyer lighting, while the deep green, cream and charcoal palette stays calm and elegant. The block heel makes sitting through a performance and moving between seats easy, and the jacket gives enough warmth for the cool autumn evening without needing a heavier coat indoors. The burgundy bag and gold earrings add a small, refined touch of color and shine."}
